context: Pick the semantics deliberately, document the choice at the call site, and collapse to a single dispatch with a regression test for adapters lacking the tuning mixin.
description: From the 2026-08-09 adversarial review of PR #1644, deferred at merge without a tracker record. benchbox/core/runner/dataframe_runner.py _attach_applied_tuning_ledger resolves the ledger writer twice: a getattr/callable guard binds the member, then the verified local is discarded and as_tuning_ledger_writer(adapter)._write_applied_tuning_ledger re-validates the same member before an identical call (line 353). Decide whether this capability is optional-by-guard or contract-enforced, then dispatch once: either call the verified writer local directly, or drop the guard and let the capability view raise for adapters without the mixin.

anti_patterns.dont: Keep both the guard and the capability-view re-validation.
anti_patterns.instead: Dispatch once through whichever mechanism matches the decided semantics.
anti_patterns.why: Double dispatch obscures whether the capability is optional or contract-enforced.

anti_patterns.dont: Silently change behavior for adapters without the mixin while simplifying.
anti_patterns.instead: Cover the no-mixin adapter path with an explicit regression test.
anti_patterns.why: A refactor and a contract change must be separately visible.

preserves.behavior: Adapters without the tuning mixin keep their current no-ledger behavior unless the contract decision explicitly changes it.
Built results carry applied_tuning_ledger, applied_ledger_hash, and tuning_validation_status exactly as before.
Dataframe runner lifecycle behavior is otherwise unchanged.

prior_art.concept: Completed capability-protocol item that introduced the capability view.

verifications.description: Single dispatch at the ledger call site
verifications.expected: Exits 1 on the unfixed tree while the double dispatch exists; exits 0 after the collapse.
Ledger attachment and no-mixin behavior are unchanged.

verifications.command: uv run -- ruff check benchbox/core/runner/dataframe_runner.py tests/unit/core/runner

work_units.summary: Decide optional-by-guard versus contract-enforced semantics and record the rationale at the call site
Collapse to a single dispatch and add a regression test covering an adapter without the tuning mixin
